title_original: 국선변호정책심의위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 1 (Establishment of the Committee for Deliberation on Public Defense Policy) The Committee for Deliberation on Public Defense Policy (hereinafter referred to as the "Committee") shall be established in the National Court Administration to deliberate and resolve important matters concerning the formulation of policies for public defense, the operation and improvement of the relevant system, and other related matters.
